label: Form SSA-1099 ordinary Social Security benefits source vocabulary for tax year 2025

fact_types.title: Box 3 total benefits paid in 2025 on one logical Form SSA-1099 statement; identity is payer, statement instance, and year, never evidence. Reconciled against box 4 and box 5 before admission; never itself the family member aggregated into the closed subtotal.

Box 4 benefits repaid to SSA in 2025 on the same logical Form SSA-1099 statement as box 3 and box 5. Repayment greater than gross benefits is a hard admission block, never an excess-repayment deduction or credit.

Box 5 net benefits for 2025 on one logical Form SSA-1099 statement; the source-family member aggregated into the closed subtotal. Admitted only when it equals box 3 minus box 4 exactly and is nonnegative, the statement kind is ordinary SSA-1099, the beneficiary subject is the taxpayer or joint-return spouse, no lump-sum election applies, and box 6 withholding is absent or zero.

Authoritative beneficiary subject on the same logical Form SSA-1099 statement as box 5: the return's taxpayer or, on a joint return, the taxpayer's spouse. No personal name or SSN enters this fact; a statement for any other person is outside the bounded class.

Statement kind on the same logical statement as box 5; documents the full equivalent-benefit domain but the bounded class admits only ordinary Form SSA-1099. RRB-1099 tier-1/SSEB, SSA-1042S nonresident/foreign, and other foreign social-benefit statements are outside this milestone.

Explicit companion witness on the same logical statement as box 5: whether a prior-year lump-sum election applies. Only explicit false is admitted; the bounded class never invents the lump-sum method.

Explicit companion authority for Form SSA-1099 box 6 (voluntary federal income tax withheld) on the same logical statement as box 5. Only explicit null (absent) or numeric zero is admissible on the bounded ordinary route; a positive value is a hard admission block and never creates a withholding/payment computation in this milestone.

User-attested closure of the Form SSA-1099 ordinary-benefits source family for 2025, keyed on the family membership horizon current at attestation (ADR-0017): true asserts every furnished ordinary SSA-1099 net-benefit statement for the taxpayer and joint-return spouse is recorded as of that horizon. A later membership transition displaces this closure through horizon succession; re-attestation on the successor horizon is required.
